name: Build the seat inventory, the seat sheet, and the assessment rubric's structure
text_content:
Type: instrument

Per specifications I1, I2, and I7. The inventory is the versioned list on the partners' page from which alone a Greenhouse job may be created, carrying every seat of every period including periods without a ratified charter, marked drafted. The seat sheet is the artifact that opens a seat and is also the seat's documented competency requirements that the invisible advocate reads, one account per seat: sixteen fields, none blank, none marked "to be determined," built on canon's photographer-selection form of must demonstrate, immediate disqualifiers, and a cultural-fluency evaluation. Field 8 is the assessment rubric, specified here as a structure and filled by Session 6. The sheet lives on the team home in every language the team speaks, is the source the posting is derived from, is readable by a candidate before the first interview, and changes only by versioned decision with every open candidate re-read against the new version. Refusals are load-bearing: no "fit," no years-of-experience requirement, no credential where a competency is meant, no competency no stage can assess, no figure, no service period without a ratified charter, no title implying altitude, no second account of the seat anywhere else. Gated on the document methodology, on W3 for the inventory's owner, and on W1 for kitchen sheets.

Filed by Session 5 of the Scaling People translation program. Session task 86ajgmhm4. Reasoning lives on the S5 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc 2ky45bmy-17253.
